notes:
- Accrual, Collection / Payment and Transfer open their own lists first; separate buttons for each direction: New receivable accrual, New payable accrual, New collection, New payment, New transfer (also on All transactions and Due tracking)
- The base currency equivalent is shown under every amount in another currency in the transaction lists, due tracking and reports; the ≈ button above a table hides or shows them
- Monthly accruals and payments: choose which lines to show (accrual, payment, remaining or all), search by account and show only accounts with a remaining amount
- Home page: exchange rates and quick actions are no longer shown by default (rates can be added back)
- The note field on entry forms is two lines high
- Filters open from the Filter button as a drop-down panel instead of a fixed panel on the left; Esc or a click outside closes it
- Transaction types are shown in their own colors in the transaction lists
- Definitions (account types, account and transaction categories, payment methods, units, due templates) have colors: automatic, or chosen in Definitions; they are shown in lists and reports
- Categories: a main category with sub-categories can no longer be assigned (choose a sub-category), and a main category already in use cannot get sub-categories
- Customer, Supplier and Other are built-in account types like Employee and Student: always active, their names can be changed
- Receivable and payable accruals can be imported from Excel (Transactions > Accrual > Import from Excel): download the template, fill it in and every row is checked before anything is saved
- Error reports never contain anything typed into records: account names, codes, notes, addresses and other entered values are recognized and hidden
- The full list is now called "All transactions"
- Monthly accruals and payments: the remaining line stands out, the yearly total is the first column, and the account type is chosen from a drop-down (employees, students, customers, suppliers, other or all)
- Screenshots and screen recording of the app window are blocked on Windows and macOS
- Error reports (Settings → Error reports): unexpected errors are recorded on this computer only, without personal data; you can preview a report and save it to share with support. Nothing is sent automatically
- If a screen fails, a message with a Reload button appears instead of an empty window
